title: TradeWar: A Benchmark for Execution-Grounded Trade Negotiation with Adaptive LLM Agents
title_zh: TradeWar：一个基于执行验证、面向自适应LLM智能体的贸易谈判基准

paragraphs.en: 提出TradeWar贸易谈判基准与TACTIC智能体，通过执行验证和跨轮经验自适应显著提升谈判的经济健康指数。 Multi-turn negotiation remains a challenging problem for large language model (LLM) agents. While LLMs can conduct natural-language dialogue, existing benchmarks predominantly assess only agreement rates, overlooking whether negotiated commitments actually create value once executed. To address this gap, we introduce TradeWar, a multi-country simulation benchmark that translates negotiation dialogues into concrete tariff and trade-share policies, enforces capacity and network constraints during settlement, and evaluates outcomes via an Economic Health Index (EHI). To solve this execution-grounded task, we propose TACTIC (Trade-aware Adaptive Consolidation and Theory-of-mind for International Commerce), an agent that iteratively refines its negotiation strategy across episodes-without updating base LLM weights-by leveraging prior experience, opponent behavior, and past settlement outcomes. Despite using zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, PromptLLM attains a 75% agreement rate but only 57.1 final EHI (*100), whereas TACTIC reaches 68.8. Across 20 sequential episodes and three seeds, TACTIC's final EHI improves from 58.2 to 73.2, compared with 65.2 for an ablation without cross-episode updates. Under technology-controls and energy-crisis shocks, TACTIC also exhibits smaller performance degradation than PromptLLM and MemoryLLM. These results indicate that CoT deliberation and interaction memory alone do not fully address delayed execution feedback, whereas settlement-grounded adaptation improves long-horizon negotiation in TradeWar.
paragraphs.zh: 提出TradeWar贸易谈判基准与TACTIC智能体，通过执行验证和跨轮经验自适应显著提升谈判的经济健康指数。多轮谈判对大语言模型（LLM）智能体而言仍然是一个具有挑战性的问题。 尽管大语言模型能够进行自然语言对话，但现有基准主要只评估达成协议的比率，忽视了谈判达成的承诺在实际执行后是否真正创造价值。 为填补这一空白，我们提出TradeWar，一个多国仿真基准，它将谈判对话转化为具体的关税与贸易份额政策，在结算时执行产能与网络约束，并通过经济健康指数（EHI）评估结果。 为了解决这一以执行为基础的任务，我们提出TACTIC（面向国际贸易的贸易感知自适应整合与心智理论），该智能体通过利用先前经验、对手行为和过往结算结果，在多个回合中迭代优化其谈判策略，而无需更新基座大语言模型的权重。 尽管使用零样本思维链（CoT）提示，PromptLLM达到了75%的协议达成率，但最终EHI（*100）仅为57.1，而TACTIC达到68.8。 在20个连续回合和三个随机种子下，TACTIC的最终EHI从58.2提升到73.2，而去除跨回合更新的消融版本仅为65.2。 在技术管制和能源危机冲击下，TACTIC的性能退化也小于PromptLLM和MemoryLLM。 这些结果表明，仅靠思维链推理和交互记忆无法完全应对延迟的执行反馈，而基于结算的自适应能够改进TradeWar中的长程谈判。
